How to stop each one · 12
  charge customers       Cancel these actions in the copy,
                         or make sure WooCommerce
                         Subscriptions starts in staging
                         mode
                         wp_actionscheduler_actions ·
                         woocommerce_scheduled_subscription_payment
  send email             Point the mailer at a mail catcher
                         such as Mailpit, or turn it off, in
                         the copy
                         wp_options · wp_mail_smtp
  take live payments     Switch the gateway to test or
                         sandbox mode and remove the live
                         keys in the copy
                         wp_options ·
                         woocommerce_stripe_settings
  post to webhooks       Set status to 'disabled' (or delete
                         the rows) in the copy
                         wp_wc_webhooks
  upload backups         Remove the remote storage in
                         UpdraftPlus's settings in the copy,
                         or turn its backup schedule off
                         wp_options · updraft_service
  email members          Turn these emails off in
                         WooCommerce > Settings > Emails in
                         the copy, or route mail to a
                         catcher such as Mailpit
                         wp_options
  act as the live site   Disconnect the copy: delete the
                         blog token in
                         jetpack_private_options and the
                         auth entry in
                         woocommerce_helper_data, or define
                         JETPACK_STAGING_MODE in its
                         wp-config.php
                         wp_options
  run scheduled actions  Cancel pending actions in the copy,
                         or turn off WP-Cron and Action
                         Scheduler there
                         wp_actionscheduler_actions
  run cron events        Turn cron off on the copy's host
                         (DISABLE_WP_CRON stops runs on page
                         loads, not a system cron), and
                         change the plugins' own settings,
                         since they schedule their events
                         again
                         wp_options · cron
  email store staff      Set these emails to off in
                         WooCommerce > Settings > Emails in
                         the copy, or route mail to a
                         catcher such as Mailpit
                         wp_options ·
                         woocommerce_new_order_settings
  email staff            Point these settings at a test
                         address, or route mail to a catcher
                         such as Mailpit, in the copy
                         wp_options
  email form recipients  Route mail to a catcher such as
                         Mailpit in the copy, or add
                         demo_mode: on to each form's
                         Additional Settings
                         wp_postmeta · _mail

What staging could do to real people · 12
  CRITICAL  charge customers
    6 subscription renewal payments are scheduled; staging
    would try to charge customers when they fall due
  HIGH      send email
    Outgoing email is sent through WP Mail SMTP (mailer:
    sendgrid)
  HIGH      take live payments
    Payment gateway "stripe" is enabled in live mode
  HIGH      post to webhooks
    2 active webhooks would send order and customer data
    from staging to their delivery URLs
  HIGH      upload backups
    UpdraftPlus backups are scheduled and go to Amazon S3;
    staging would send its backups there too
  HIGH      email members
    2 WooCommerce Memberships emails are enabled; staging
    would send them to members, for example when a
    membership ends
  HIGH      act as the live site
    The copy keeps the live site's Jetpack connection;
    connected services would act for the live site, and
    WooCommerce Shipping, Tax or Payments are active
  MEDIUM    run scheduled actions
    40 pending scheduled actions would run on staging (most
    common: woocommerce_cleanup_draft_orders (20),
    wc-admin_import_orders (14),
    woocommerce_scheduled_subscription_payment (6))
  MEDIUM    run cron events
    5 WP-Cron events would run on staging, including
    UpdraftPlus backups, WPForms email summaries,
    WooCommerce usage tracking and Ultimate Member jobs
    (most common: um_daily_scheduled_events (1),
    updraft_backup (1), woocommerce_tracker_send_event (1))
  MEDIUM    email store staff
    WooCommerce emails store staff about new and cancelled
    orders; staging would email them too
  MEDIUM    email staff
    1 plugin setting sends notification emails to staff
    addresses (for example fixture_admin_recipient)
  MEDIUM    email form recipients
    1 Contact Form 7 form emails its submissions to the
    addresses in its settings
